response.rationale: A's "Ticket Booking" is made in RinkService (src/business/rinkService.ts, node 21c65604dec116b1) by `this.bookings.create({`. According to the graph, RinkService calls BookingRepository.create. B's "Booking" is the entity managed by BookingRepository (src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts, node 2e3c5728fffb0180), which has `create(data: Omit<Booking, "id">): Booking {`. B's incoming calls include RinkService.purchase and RinkService.holdSession. So A and B are the same Booking record: one view comes from the business service, the other from the persistence layer.
